title: Ex-Ante ERW Pipeline
subtitle: Geospatial profitability model for Enhanced Rock Weathering with basalt in Sub-Saharan Africa (erw/erw-*)
scope: Sub-Saharan Africa, 23 SPAM crops, SoilGrids soil properties, EcoCrop response curves, FAOSTAT 2016–2020 prices, basalt feedstock chemistry with grain-size lever

pipelines.name: ERW Ex-Ante
pipelines.summary: Geospatial profitability model for Enhanced Rock Weathering with basalt. Builds the SSA soil + SPAM working grid, computes lime-equivalent and basalt application rates with feedstock chemistry as a decision variable, climate-and-pH-scaled CDR yield with an aridity-driven pedogenic-carbonate deduction, spatial delivered-basalt-price and country-energy surfaces, decomposed-cost profitability with derived LCA, a Bayesian agronomic-uplift module, supply-constrained deployment ranking, and five sensitivity sweeps.

stages.name: Install packages
stages.purpose: Bootstrap R dependencies for the pipeline.
outputs: installed: terra, geodata, limer, Recocrop, brms, malariaAtlas, readxl, reshape2, viridis

stages.name: SoilGrids layers
stages.purpose: Build SSA mask, pull SoilGrids depth-weighted soil properties (pH, bulk density, exchangeable acidity, K/Ca/Mg/Na bases) and a QED cropland mask, derive ECEC and acidity saturation.

stages.name: SPAM crop layers
stages.purpose: Pull SPAM harvested area, production, and yield for 23 crops, crop to SSA, resample to the SoilGrids grid aggregated 10x.

stages.name: Basalt requirements
stages.purpose: Compute lime-equivalent CaCO3 rates (Kamprath, Cochrane, Aramburu-Merlos LiTAS year-1 and maintenance) via limer::limeRate, then convert to t basalt/ha using user-set feedstock chemistry (10% CaO + 7% MgO by default), Lewis-2021-calibrated reactive fraction (0.20 of stoichiometric at reference grain × climate), and a grain-size lever. Produces both LiTAS-targeted rates and uniform-rate (10/20/50 t/ha) rasters.

key_constants.name: CaO_frac
key_constants.notes: Mass fraction of CaO in basalt feedstock (typical tropical basalt).

key_constants.name: MgO_frac
key_constants.notes: Mass fraction of MgO in basalt feedstock.

key_constants.name: grain_size_um
key_constants.notes: Decision variable. Sweeps 10–500 µm in erw-8.

key_constants.name: reactive_fraction_ref
key_constants.notes: Lewis 2021 calibration at reference grain × climate.

key_constants.name: GRAIN_BETA
key_constants.notes: Surface-area exponent for the grain-size reactivity factor.

stages.name: Crop parameters
stages.purpose: Build per-crop EcoCrop pH and acidity-saturation tolerance tables for the 23 SPAM crops. Produces a crop-type lookup (cereal / legume / RTB / commodity) and response-curve figures.

stages.name: Yield-loss function
stages.purpose: Run Recocrop::ecocrop per crop × response (pH and acidity saturation) on the cropland-masked soil stack to produce relative-yield rasters, clamped to [0.2, 1]. erw-7 falls back to these when erw-yield-predict outputs are absent.

stages.name: CDR yield
stages.purpose: Per-pixel CDR (t CO2/ha cumulative): climate-and-pH scaling on the per-tonne CDR potential, with an aridity-driven pedogenic-carbonate deduction that removes alkalinity precipitating locally rather than exporting to the ocean.

key_constants.name: pedogenic_frac
key_constants.notes: UNEP 1992 aridity bands using MAP as v1 proxy for AI=P/PET.

stages.name: Basalt access
stages.purpose: Per-pixel delivered basalt price ($/t) = quarry-gate price + cost-distance × $/min/t. Uses GLiM lithology (basic volcanic) for sources and the Malaria Atlas Project friction surface for cost-distance accumulation.

key_constants.name: QUARRY_GATE_PRICE
key_constants.notes: Basalt fines as quarry by-product. Range $5–40/t.

key_constants.name: EFFECTIVE_KM_PER_MIN
key_constants.notes: Avg effective speed for distance approximation.

key_constants.name: MAX_HAUL_KM
key_constants.notes: Beyond cap, lifecycle emissions likely erase the credit.

stages.name: Country energy
stages.purpose: Per-country electricity price ($/kWh, industrial tariff) and grid carbon intensity (kg CO2/kWh) rasters for SSA. Drives spatially-varying grinding economics and grinding LCA in erw-7.

key_constants.name: energy table
key_constants.notes: Approximate values from IEA / Ember / GET.invest 2022–2024 — edit CSV in script and re-run.

stages.name: Yield fit (Bayesian)
stages.purpose: Bayesian hierarchical regression of log(yield_with_basalt / yield_control) on rate, baseline pH, climate, grain size, and crop type. Fitted on the manually-compiled trial dataset (~14 rows; prior-dominated). Provides a measurement-error-aware framework that grows as new ERW field trials are appended.

key_constants.name: priors
key_constants.notes: Intercept N(0.10, 0.20); log_rate N(0.05, 0.05); log_grain N(-0.05, 0.05); SDs Exponential(5).

stages.name: Yield predict
stages.purpose: Apply the brmsfit posterior means to per-pixel covariates (pH, MAT, MAP, grain) and per-crop random intercepts to produce yield-uplift rasters. erw-7 consumes these in place of EcoCrop-derived yield response when present.

stages.name: Profitability (ERW)
stages.purpose: Decomposed cost (quarry + grinding + transport + spreading), derived per-pixel LCA from grinding × grid-CI + transport-km × truck-CO2 + spreading, MRV deduction from the carbon credit, time-resolved CDR (NPV regime), and four allocation rules (LiTAS-targeted + uniform 10/20/50 t/ha). Auto-detects basalt-access and country-energy rasters; falls back to flat constants when absent. Emits agronomic-only, CDR-only, and combined gross-margin layers.

stages.name: Sensitivity (ERW)
stages.purpose: Five sweeps: (1) crop-price × basalt-price × carbon-price grid; (2) yield-factor 1.0–2.5; (3) MRV cost 0–80 $/tCO2; (4) grain size 10/30/50/100/200/500 µm; (5) allocation rule (targeted + uniform_{10,20,50}). All sweeps run all three regimes (year1/npv/equilibrium) and 23 crops.

stages.name: Supply ranking
stages.purpose: Supply-constrained deployment frontier: ranks SSA cropland pixels descending by GM-per-tonne-basalt (the LP-dual on the basalt supply constraint), produces supply curves for 1–500 Mt/yr caps and deployment masks for selected caps.

documents.purpose: Evidence review on ERW: chemistry, feedstocks, application practice, CDR potential, agronomic co-benefits, SSA case, risks, economics.
Runbook: file inventory, run order, key constants, deferred work, output schema, and known portability issues.
Catalogue of every constant and assumption used by erw-*.R scripts, with citations, source URLs/DOIs, and units.

headline_outputs.name: ERW profitability map
headline_outputs.what: Per-pixel agronomic-only, CDR-only, and combined gross margin for basalt-ERW deployment, four allocation rules × three regimes.

headline_outputs.name: Delivered basalt price surface
headline_outputs.what: Spatial cost of basalt at farm gate ($/t).

headline_outputs.name: CDR yield surface
headline_outputs.what: Per-pixel cumulative CDR (t CO2/ha) net of pedogenic precipitation.

headline_outputs.name: Supply curves
headline_outputs.what: Marginal $/tCO2 and total CDR vs annual basalt supply cap (1–500 Mt/yr).

headline_outputs.name: Sensitivity tables
headline_outputs.what: Total profitable hectares and gross margin under price, yield, MRV, grain, and allocation scenarios.
